items.description: Battery jumpstart, flat tyre, towing—essential for a premium sedan. Costs ~₹300 annually but saves ₹2,000-₹5,000 per breakdown incident.

items.title: Key Replacement Cover Unavailable
items.description: Audi smart keys cost ₹15,000-₹25,000 to replace. This add-on (~₹500/year) covers loss or damage.

whatToDo: Verify IDV against current resale value for 2015 Audi A6 35 TFSI Premium in Delhi market.
Check platforms like Cars24, Spinny, or authorized Audi dealer quotes to confirm ₹13-14 lakh range is accurate.
Consider a slightly higher IDV (₹13.5-14 lakh) if market value supports it—better total loss protection for marginal premium increase.
idvCheck.tip: For an 11-year-old luxury sedan, accurate IDV is critical. Compare with 3-4 resale quotes to ensure you're neither under-insured nor overpaying premium.

items.title: Check Garage Network in Pune & Delhi
items.description: Ensure strong authorized Audi service centre coverage in Pune (Magarpatta area), Delhi (vehicle RTO), and NCR. Premium cars need quality repairs.

items.title: Preserve Your 25% NCB
items.description: Avoid small claims under ₹15,000-₹20,000. Self-pay minor repairs to protect your NCB—one claim resets it to 0%, costing you ₹1,533+ annually.

items.title: Prioritize Claim Settlement Quality
items.description: For an Audi, cashless network quality and settlement speed matter more than saving ₹2,000-₹3,000 on premium. Choose insurers with strong luxury car expertise.

items.title: Add Essential Coverage, Not Everything
items.description: Focus on Engine Protect, Zero Dep (if available), NCB Protection, and Consumables. Skip unnecessary add-ons like Loss of Personal Belongings.

items.title: Use Insurance for Major Events Only
items.description: Reserve claims for accidents, theft, flood, or repairs exceeding ₹25,000. Self-insure minor scratches and dents to keep NCB intact.

items.title: Review Add-Ons Annually
items.description: As your Audi ages, reassess which add-ons deliver value. Zero Dep becomes less cost-effective after 10 years, but Engine Protect and Consumables gain importance.

pricingSnapshot.narrative: Your current premium of ₹15,480 is lean but leaves critical gaps. A well-rounded policy with Engine Protect, NCB Protection, Consumables, and Roadside Assistance would cost ₹18,500-₹22,000—a ₹3,000-₹6,500 increase. This isn't overpaying; it's right-sizing coverage to avoid ₹50,000-₹2,00,000+ out-of-pocket expenses during claims. For an 11-year-old Audi, the small premium bump delivers disproportionate claim-time protection.
pricingSnapshot.claimTimeExample: If your engine suffers hydrostatic lock during Delhi's monsoon flooding (common in low-lying areas), Engine Protector could save you ₹2,00,000-₹5,00,000 in repair costs—recovering 30-80 years of the ₹2,500 add-on premium in a single claim.

keyTakeaway.headline: Your 11-year-old Audi A6 needs strategic, not minimal, coverage.
keyTakeaway.body: Your current policy covers the basics but leaves you exposed to ₹50,000-₹5,00,000 in claim-time gaps. Adding Engine Protect, NCB Protection, Consumables, and Roadside Assistance for ₹3,000-₹6,500 more transforms your policy from bare-bones to battle-ready—critical for an aging luxury sedan in Delhi/Pune conditions. Smart coverage today prevents massive out-of-pocket costs tomorrow.

addOnRecommendations.name: Zero Depreciation
addOnRecommendations.reasoning: Limited benefit for an 11-year-old vehicle (30-50% depreciation already baked in), but Audi parts are expensive—could still save ₹30,000-₹80,000 in a major accident if available and reasonably priced.

addOnRecommendations.name: Engine Protector
addOnRecommendations.reasoning: Critical for Delhi's monsoon flooding and waterlogging risks—engine damage on an Audi costs ₹2,00,000-₹5,00,000, far exceeding years of premium.

addOnRecommendations.name: Return to Invoice
addOnRecommendations.reasoning: Not relevant for an 11-year-old vehicle—invoice value vs IDV gap is minimal (₹13.3 lakh vs original ~₹45 lakh), making this add-on poor value.

addOnRecommendations.name: Roadside Assistance
addOnRecommendations.reasoning: Universal utility for any vehicle—battery, tyre, towing emergencies cost ₹2,000-₹5,000 each; this add-on costs ~₹300 annually.

addOnRecommendations.name: NCB Protection
addOnRecommendations.reasoning: Your 25% NCB is worth ₹1,533 annually—one claim wipes it out. Protecting it for ~₹800 preserves thousands in future savings.

addOnRecommendations.name: Consumables
addOnRecommendations.reasoning: Critical for an 11-year-old luxury car—oil, coolant, AC gas, nuts/bolts add ₹5,000-₹15,000 out-of-pocket per claim without this cover.

addOnRecommendations.name: Key Replacement
addOnRecommendations.reasoning: Audi smart keys cost ₹15,000-₹25,000 to replace—this ₹500 add-on is good insurance if you're prone to losing keys.

addOnRecommendations.name: Loss of Personal Belongings
addOnRecommendations.reasoning: Low utility for most customers—limited coverage (₹5,000-₹10,000) doesn't justify premium for a family sedan owner.
